# Default audio device (`audio.default_device`)

**Kind:** action · **Category:** Audio · **Runs as:** the signed-in user · **Revertible:** yes

Makes a device the default speaker/headphones or microphone.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `device` | text | yes |  | Part of the device name as shown in Sound settings. Supports [placeholders](../placeholders.md). |
| `flow` | one of: `output`, `input` | no | `output` | output (playback) or input (recording). |
| `role` | one of: `all`, `multimedia`, `communications` | no | `all` | Which default to change: all, multimedia (default device) or communications (default communication device). |
| `continue_on_error` | true / false | no | `false` | Keep running the next actions even if this one fails. |

## Example

```yaml
actions:
  - type: audio.default_device
    device: Headphones
```

## In profiles

When this action is part of a [profile](../../guide/profiles.md), the current value is saved before it runs and
restored when the profile is reverted. Two actions of this type change the same setting when their `flow` and `role` are the same.
